Acknowledge 25.4x k_fs inverted redshift scaling and 282x Delta N_eff energy violation in neutrino decay microphysics.
Concede that DESI neutrino mass bound is geometric distance tension (dH0/dm_nu = -10.3), rendering Lyman-alpha arbitration moot.
